$comment: Maps each owned REST/API spec to its owning Gradle module and the product buckets it targets. specPath is a bare filename (flat single-folder repo). 'targets' lists the products whose documentation include the spec; when omitted the spec is included in all of [idk,edk,vdx]. It also supplies the default product-availability badge. 'division' is the spec's origin/authoring layer (label only, not a folder). 'targets' does not by itself gate runtime serving: the live /openapi console advertises the specs whose declared paths are actually mounted in a build (route-table introspection), so the catalog is consumed mainly by documentation aggregation and codegen. 'unbound' specs have no runtime owner and appear in documentation only.

specs.note: EDK/VDX include these backend session endpoints via oid4vp-verifier-openapi.yaml ($ref), so the universal session spec is listed standalone only under IDK (mirrors oid4vci-issuer-session).
EDK/VDX include these backend endpoints via oid4vci-issuer-openapi.yaml ($ref), so the session spec is listed standalone only under IDK.

Session-oriented REST projection of the neutral wallet interaction commands under /api/wallet/interaction/v1: entry-point capture, interaction state machine actions, sensitive-input registration by opaque handle, bounded SSE replay, frame transport, and the per-wallet activity log projection.

Holder-facing stored-credential surface under /api/wallet/credentials/v1: metadata sidecar listing, sanitized display projection, policy-gated deletion, and unattended status refresh. Raw credential bodies are never returned. ownerModule is the new Kotlin wallet-app-client-rest module.

Platform and tenant control surface (PlatformAdmin + Tenants/TenantSignup + TenantFederation + OwnerBootstrap). Served across multiple REST adapters; the broadest owner is recorded in ownerModule, the rest in additionalOwnerModules.

Anonymous first-run setup surface under /api/platform/setup/v1. Delegates signed license request generation to KMS and license verify/install to application-admin services; the route disappears after the durable bootstrap gate closes.

Browser-safe platform runtime bootstrap surface under /api/platform/bootstrap/v1. Exposes platform/auth/API wiring and capability flags only; business-authored credential designs, DCQL queries, issuer/verifier artifacts, operational records, and secrets remain in their dedicated APIs.
Workload-protected thin OAuth-client facade under /api/platform/internal/v1/bff/oauth-client. It holds BFF OAuth client state and is not an authorization-server session authority.
Mounted-service runtime catalog and browser-safe bootstrap. Protected tenant operations remain inaccessible anonymously; Postman artifacts contain placeholders only.

Service-instance configuration API for AS token/grant/feature settings, OAuth2 public-client registry management, typed KMS resource administration, and OID4VCI issuer/OID4VP verifier runtime configuration under /api/platform/config/v1. The tenant KMS process is execution-only and owns no public REST spec.

Greenfield platform and tenant secret-storage control plane. Provider changes are revisioned and assignment changes occur only through fenced migrations; no legacy provider-selection routes are part of this API.
Dedicated audit query surface under /api/audit/v1. It exposes read-only audit records independently from platform-admin so deployments can authorize audit access with dedicated roles.

Tenant webhook registry and delivery log under /api/webhook/v1. Endpoints subscribe an https receiver to issuance, verification, and status-list events at tenant or instance scope; deliveries are signed with HMAC-SHA256 and retried by an EDK-local worker over the event transmission tables. Per-session OID4VCI and OID4VP callbacks reuse the same signing and delivery log.

Tenant-scoped trust-domain, trust-anchor, binding, and anchor-resolution API under /api/trust-domain/v1. Used by EDK and VDX trust-establishment flows for X.509, ETSI, DID, OpenID Federation, issuer validation, verifier validation, and credential-specific trust domains.
TS 11 catalog management API under /api/catalog/v1. Public SchemaMeta reads live under /public/catalogs/{slug}/api/v1/ and are not part of this authenticated mount.

Optional Wallet Unit backend under /api/wallet-unit/v1 for lifecycle, activation evidence, TS03 WIA/KA attestation, Wallet Provider/Solution trust evidence, status-list subjects, and policy-gated wallet-key signing. It does not enforce OID4VCI PAR/token/credential requests and does not implement reset, notification, or conformance reporting workflows.
Authenticated managed-wallet new-app recovery, successor migration, complete-unit backup verification and restore drills, and protected vault portability under /api/wallet-recovery/v1.

Authenticated assigned business-wallet operations under /api/business-conduit/v1. Responses expose only UI-safe assignment and interaction projections; protected captures, policy authority and egress evidence remain server-side.

Tenant branding and theming API under /api/theme/v1: public theme/CSS/feature resolution, tenant and per-application brand administration, application registry, features and design element bindings, definitions, tokens, stylesheets, and palette/seed/cache operations.

Wallet feature entitlement admin and signed manifest API under /api/wallet-entitlement/v1 for tenant/org-unit/group/person feature resolution, license-ceiling intersection, and wallet-side manifest fetch.

Authenticated durable enterprise-wallet onboarding under /api/wallet-onboarding/v1. Trusted Identity, Party, relationship, policy, and provisioning bindings are resolved server-side and never accepted from request bodies.

Tenant asset library under /api/assets/v1 (namespace-scoped upload/list/get/delete with SHA-256 content addressing and per-tenant dedup) plus the public unversioned hosting mount /public/assets/{tenantId}/{namespace}/{asset}.

Authenticated license issuer portal API under /api/license-portal/v1 for partners, customers, deployments, imported customer license requests, issuance, protected setup bundles, and license revocation.
Identity and identity identifier management surface under /api/identity/v1.

Software and instance manager surface (generic ServiceInstances + typed AuthorizationServers/Oid4vciIssuers/Oid4vpVerifiers). Served by the VDX service-rest adapters (ServiceInstanceHttpAdapter, AuthorizationServerHttpAdapter, Oid4vciIssuerHttpAdapter, Oid4vpVerifierAdminHttpAdapter) under one base path /api/services/v1. Models are codegen'd by data-store-service-api from this single spec.
Executable 0.2.0 guided and expert authoring, legal-source, interpretation, requirement, policy-binding, template, interchange, import, and semantic-release paths.
Executable 0.2.0 typed mutation, stream, staged replay, organization graph, case, evidence, receipt, timeline, lineage, and activation paths.
Executable 0.2.0 protected form correlation and generic lifecycle command paths.

One spec covering invitation management (authenticated, served by service-invitation-rest) plus the public recipient-facing redemption + IDV callback (served by service-issuance-redemption-rest). Both adapters mount under /api/invitation/v1.
Single end-to-end batch-invite orchestration route mounted at /api/v1/batch-invite by BatchInviteOrchestratorHttpEndpoint; drives the tabular source, batch engine, and invitation mint in one call.
Public single-use identity activation and password-change resolve/complete surface under /api/account-actions/v1.
Verify ownerModule project name (vdx/data/store/oid4vp-dcql-binding/rest).
Workflow authoring API; expression endpoints remain owned by the expression evaluator follow-up.
Run-time workflow execution API under /api/workflow/v1: start a form-bound execution, read its live state, list and complete its parked HUMAN tasks. Shares the mount with the authoring API.

unbound.note: Canonical cross-product Inbox contract under /api/inbox/v1. The public contract and maintained remote modules own contract semantics and generated-client input only; no runtime REST adapter is claimed until a real implementation is mounted.
API-design-first canonical BlobStore surface under /api/blob-store/v1, aligned with the IDK BlobService contract. Runtime REST ownership remains unconfirmed until the adapter is implemented.
API-design-first canonical generic vault surface under /api/vault/v1, aligned with the IDK VaultService contract. Runtime REST ownership remains unconfirmed until the adapter is implemented.
EDK DCQL authoring/versioning layer ($ref-extends the idk dcql base). Runtime owner of authoring/versioning endpoints unconfirmed; documentation-only until wired.

Greenfield API-design-first Connector Registry API under /api/connector/v1. Part of the platform service settings plan, intentionally separate from platform-config until runtime ownership is implemented.
Curated external connector integration profile derived from the v1 Connector Registry API for third-party connector builders, SDK consumers, and low-code importers.
Versioned external Enable-U BRP/KVK lookup contract consumed by the generic HTTP/OpenAPI connector runtime. It is documentation and generated-client input, not a VDX-mounted REST service.

Tenant-scoped reusable OID4VCI issuance templates under /api/oid4vci/v1 that store stable credential-offer settings and execute against the existing issuer-session credential-offer path. Bundled by admin-api-client codegen; runtime owner module unconfirmed until wired.

Tenant-scoped reusable OID4VP verification templates under /api/oid4vp/v1 that store stable authorization-request settings and execute against the universal verifier-session create-authorization-request path. Bundled by admin-api-client codegen; runtime owner module unconfirmed until wired.
